objective: Implement QIF v0.6.40 Policy Counterfactual Replay

assignment.assignment_reason: Builder owns schema, deterministic replay verifier, fixtures, plain-language docs, AOF evidence, and release packaging.

capability_fit.rationale: existing immutable route-policy snapshots, selective escalation decisions, outcome pairs, loss boundaries, governance, and fixture generator support a narrow replay extension

acceptance_criteria: baseline snapshot, preserved decision, identical evidence, candidate rules, selected rule and route, route change, and hypothetical loss-boundary impact are reproducible
severe, uncertain, incomplete, or unverified replay evidence triggers governance
negative fixtures reject optimization, authority, mutation, evidence substitution, and overclaiming

review_criteria.criterion: counterfactual replay preserves baseline authority and labels loss-boundary impacts as hypothetical
review_criteria.evidence_required: schema, verifier, example, full fixtures, and release notes

blocker_semantics.trigger_condition: replay optimizes, ranks, selects, authorizes, mutates, or treats hypothetical impact as observed truth
blocker_semantics.recovery_action: restore candidate-only authority, identical evidence, hypothetical labeling, and governance

hri_projection.speech_bubble: I compare policy paths without pretending the replay chose the policy.
hri_projection.next_action: Run full fixtures and Council review
